deadline.value: The IoPPN application and project approval form for the October intake are due 1 June (registration 1 October); the page shows no year, so 2027 is inferred. These deadlines are earlier than King's Apply.
deadline.quote: Application and PAF Deadline 1 October 1 June

gre_subject.value: King's does not consider the GRE in its selection processes, so no GRE Subject test is used.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that at King's we do not consider the GRE in our selection processes.

supervisor.value: Two academics must agree to supervise before the application is made.
supervisor.quote: Before you make any application, you need to find two academics willing to supervise you.

funding.value: The IoPPN page says you need funding before applying unless you have a studentship or can self-fund; no competitive rule is stated.

entry_route.value: The IoPPN page lists the application items but gives no degree requirement.

notes: IoPPN runs its own application process via the Education Support Team; the King's Apply route still applies. Its English rules come from the central Band D.
